## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify compatibility or migration effects.

## Validation

List commands and actual results, including numerical/GUI evidence where relevant.
Distinguish source tests, frozen-build tests and clean-machine validation.

## Contribution and data check

- [ ] I am authorized to submit this work under the contribution terms in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Copied/adapted material is identified and required licenses/notices are preserved.
- [ ] This PR contains no credentials, private data, proprietary layouts/PDKs or restricted documents.
- [ ] Applicable documentation and independent regression coverage are updated.

Report security vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md. Do not attach
proprietary projects or credentials to a public PR or its logs/artifacts.
